tasks.objective: Fix chat input reliability — make input always accessible (not scroll-away)
acceptanceCriteria: Input bar remains visible and interactive while scrolling Today/Weekly content.
Send and Add (+) buttons render reliably on every load and never disappear after a send.
Submitting works via Enter; pending state recovers cleanly on error/timeout.
No stuck disabled input after a failed request.

tasks.objective: Add minimal Profile (weight, preferred_units) + weight event type to data model
acceptanceCriteria: New profiles table (userId PK, weight_kg nullable, preferred_units, timestamps); auto-created on first authenticated request.
GET/PATCH /api/profile endpoints with ownership-scoped reads/writes.
Weight supported as a log type (category/log path).
Profile row persists across refresh; retrievable via API.

tasks.objective: Add log_weight action: chat-driven weight entry + weight display today/weekly
acceptanceCriteria: New log_weight intent in ActionPayload schema + script + classifier prompt examples.
Chat "weighed 180 lbs" creates a weight event in logs and updates profile.weight.
Weight tile appears in Today/Weekly view via useTileData.
log_weight events are deletable via RM-5 correction path.

tasks.objective: Add update_goal action: edit goal target/period/unit from chat
acceptanceCriteria: New update_goal intent in ActionPayload schema + classifier support + script.
PATCH /api/goals with ownership-scoped update (404 on cross-user, no info leak).
Chat "change gym goal to 4x/week" updates existing goal target/period.
Goal remains active; only target/period/unit/metric mutate.

tasks.objective: Event correction & deletion: API + Today feed affordance
acceptanceCriteria: DELETE /api/logs/:id with ownership scope (404 cross-user, no info leak).
Today feed rows (FeedBreakdown) have a delete affordance with confirmation.
Deleting a food/workout/weight event tallies refresh immediately.
End-state test #10 passes: Incorrect information can be corrected/deleted.
Each chat request produces a trace record: input, classified intent, chosen action + args, execution status, error, latency.
Trace records are queryable via a debug endpoint (/api/ai/traces) per user.
Observability doesn't add latency to the request path (fire-and-forget).
End-state test #11 passes: can inspect how each request was interpreted and executed.

tasks.objective: UI coherence pass — actionable Today feed, dashboard cleanup, quote header removal
acceptanceCriteria: Today feed (FeedBreakdown) rows show working delete + (where cheap) edit.
Dashboard (app/dashboard.tsx) accurately reflects daily/weekly goal progress.
Static "The Stub is the Way" header removed or replaced with real content.
Consistent buttons/feedback on main interactions (send, add, increment, delete).
